facts.fact: The APDPVP, Gabon's data protection authority, is headed by its president Joël Dominique Ledaga, who spoke at the launch of its Port-Gentil awareness campaign on 10 November 2026, per AGP.
The APDPVP is led by president Joël Dominique Ledaga and is running a 10-20 November 2026 awareness campaign in Port-Gentil, per AGP.
The APDPVP launched a 10-20 November 2026 information campaign in Port-Gentil briefing administrations and businesses on their legal obligations, after earlier visits in 2019 and 2022, per AGP.
